title: coldtake eval: advisor response contract
description: What the harness asks every advisor to return, per mode and task kind. A real adapter maps the coldtake tool result onto this shape.

verdict.description: review mode only: whether the reviewer found a material defect in the lead's answer.

choice.description: decision tasks: the option id the advisor would choose (A-D), or 'none'. In review mode this is the advisor's own choice after reviewing.

proposed_fix.description: code tasks: the complete corrected module (review mode) or the advisor's own complete solution (blind mode).

comparison.description: blind modes: the router's comparison of the advisor memo with the sealed lead answer.
